correction_items.current behavior: Candidates are priced and inserted into the stack universe before role/cultural qualification is computed. The qualification result is persisted as disclosure only and is ignored by stack, component, ranking, and scenario-category logic.
correction_items.correct behavior: Qualification must produce a typed admission decision before incentive economics. Only a deterministically qualified program may enter canonical pricing/ranking; unresolved states must remain unpriced opportunities or unavailable, and hard failures must be rejected.
evidence: canonical_evaluation.py:1060 prices; 1112-1113 evaluates qualification; 1143-1150 adds StackCandidate; 1151-1262 persists PRICED
canonical_evaluation.py:1255-1259 explicitly labels qualification disclosure-only
canonical_production_view.py:274-306 does not read role_qualification
correction_items.required fix: Introduce one canonical admission result consumed by single-program, stack, component, co-production unlock, persistence, ranking, and category paths. Preserve unresolved states as non-numeric opportunity records.
correction_items.required runtime proof: API tests for every terminal qualification state prove HARD_FAIL/USER_FACT_REQUIRED/SCRIPT_FACT_REQUIRED/AUTHORITY_UNRESOLVED/RULE_DATA_INCOMPLETE cannot be PRICED, stacked, ranked, or RECOMMENDED; a fact-complete QUALIFIES control prices once through the canonical calculator.

correction_items.current behavior: Tier eligibility uses only production_type and min_qpe_usd. Sixty-four conditions across 15 other condition kinds can remain unresolved without blocking a non-band tier. Canadian labour-base programs apply their rates to total QPE; CPTC certification is not an economic admission gate.
correction_items.correct behavior: Every condition kind must have typed semantics: eligibility gate, rate-base transform/cap, uplift-only condition, exclusivity, or disclosure-only risk. Unresolved mandatory eligibility and unavailable statutory bases must block deterministic pricing.
evidence: program_rate_rules.py:1057-1068 selects tiers only by type/QPE
program_rate_rules.py:1108-1115 serializes every other kind as satisfied=None
program_rate_rules_worldwide.py:811-823 and 4400-4425 record labour base/certification, but resolver does not execute them
Direct inventory: 64 conditions in 15 unhandled kinds
correction_items.required fix: Replace free-form kind fallthrough with a closed typed condition model and evaluator. Add statutory base calculators/inputs before applying rates. Implement complete PSTC/CPTC certification and Canadian qualified-labour/net-cost controls.
correction_items.required runtime proof: PSTC cultural state is NOT_APPLICABLE and its credit uses qualified Canadian labour only. CPTC cannot price below the complete certification/points requirement and uses 25% of qualified labour subject to the current statutory cap. Each condition kind has pass/fail/unresolved tests.

correction_items.current behavior: Tables have no explicit completeness class. Script criteria are satisfied by the mere presence of any broad element type, irrespective of criterion meaning/jurisdiction. Aggregate and approximated tables are treated as executable point systems.
correction_items.correct behavior: Each table/version must state completeness and known/unknown headroom. Every criterion must use a typed semantic predicate, route/format, alternative-group and subthreshold rules. Authority-incomplete/aggregate approximations cannot produce deterministic QUALIFIES or HARD_FAIL.
evidence: cultural_point_tables.py CulturalPointTable lacks completeness metadata
canonical_role_qualification_bridge.py:316-321 awards full criterion points from any mapped type
Tokyo/US/English direct control returns fr_trip QUALIFIES at 18/18
Poland source_note admits equal-point approximation; Portugal admits aggregate-only and separate 20/8 route; seven tables use single aggregate rows
correction_items.required fix: Add completeness/version/provenance/route metadata, semantic predicates, typed territory-group matching, and quarantine rules. Migrate only authority-supported itemized points; represent residuals as unresolved headroom without invented allocation.
correction_items.required runtime proof: All 13 tables pass classification tests; unrelated Tokyo/US/English facts score zero on France-specific criteria; EEA/CoE and route variants work; partial tables cannot false-fail and incomplete tables cannot auto-qualify.

correction_items.current behavior: Nationality and residence codes are merged into one set and consumed interchangeably. Co-production facts are global rather than partner/route bound. Any non-empty boolean text other than true/1/yes becomes false.
correction_items.correct behavior: Nationality, residence, domicile, work location, eligible labour, entity control, contribution, ownership, cultural determination, and authority approval must remain distinct typed facts. Invalid/unknown data remains unresolved.
evidence: canonical_role_qualification_bridge.py:184-222 merges primary_nationality and known_residencies
cultural_qualification_model.py:393 labels known_codes citizenship/residency
canonical_evaluation.py:627-631 converts unknown text to False
correction_items.required fix: Define typed fact contracts and criterion-specific predicates; bind co-production facts to route and parties; validate booleans and numeric shares without coercing invalid input to a known outcome.
correction_items.required runtime proof: Residency cannot satisfy a citizenship-only rule, work location cannot satisfy residence, route A facts cannot qualify route B, and invalid values yield unresolved states.

correction_items.correct behavior: The canonical program requirement record must drive NOT_APPLICABLE for confirmed no-cultural-test programs. Missing authority must remain distinct. The invariant must exercise the actual served state of all 71 profiles without skips that hide a disconnect.

correction_items.required fix: Consume ProgramRequirementsProfile.cultural_test_required in the canonical qualification router or establish one reconciled classification registry; remove duplicate allowlist drift and strengthen the invariant.
correction_items.required runtime proof: Expected-state manifest covers every one of the 71 slugs; confirmed no-test programs return NOT_APPLICABLE; true missing-authority controls return AUTHORITY_UNRESOLVED/RULE_DATA_INCOMPLETE as appropriate; disconnected count is zero without skips.

Additional routes, European Convention, and Ibermedia are not consumed. Generic global shares/cultural facts are reused for all routes, no competent-authority approval is modeled, Eurimages receives no country percentages, and discovery is truncated.
correction_items.correct behavior: All represented official frameworks/routes must remain first-class canonical instruments with route-specific terms, parties, contributions/ownership, cultural rules, competent-authority status, provenance, and explicit unresolved states. Search bounds cannot silently remove material routes.

correction_items.required runtime proof: Controls for each framework prove absent vs exists/terms unknown vs fact-incomplete vs ineligible vs authority-approved eligible; no fabricated bilateral expansion; all represented routes remain discoverable independent of display limits.

correction_items.current behavior: Mounted production APIs expose the superseded run_full_analysis path, separate optimization engines, and unparameterized Little-Utopia-only state. These routes can calculate/persist or serve state outside the canonical evaluator.

Legacy/demo/admin routes must be removed or hard-isolated so they cannot mutate or masquerade as production state.

correction_items.current behavior: The fingerprint excludes personnel, screenplay, co-production, contingency, and registry/table/treaty versions. Existing current-engine rows are reused after those inputs change. GET follows the leading result's stored engine version rather than requiring current ENGINE_VERSION.
correction_items.correct behavior: Persistence identity must include every material input and canonical knowledge snapshot. GET must refuse or clearly block stale rows and trigger/require deterministic reevaluation under the current engine/knowledge versions.

correction_items.required fix: Build a canonical evaluation input manifest containing typed project facts plus all data-schema/registry versions; hash it; enforce current ENGINE_VERSION and manifest at publication; invalidate on relevant writes.
correction_items.required runtime proof: Mutating personnel, script, co-production, contingency, spend/rate/point/treaty versions changes the fingerprint and served result. An old leading row cannot be returned as current after deployment.

Registry changes rely on manual engine bumps for cache invalidation.
